newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Housing Agency $168 mln bonds repriced.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Housing Agency $168 mln bonds repriced.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co. said Wednesday it repriced California Housing Finance Agency's $168 million mortgage revenue bonds. The top yield at the repricing was 6.10 percent in 2029.
